name: Hotel AKA Boston Common
positioning: Design-led downtown Boston hotel at the crossroads of Beacon Hill, Downtown Crossing and the Financial District, with public spaces by Rafael de Cárdenas and rooms by Studio NA.GI
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Boston Common, the Freedom Trail and the theaters
Design-minded guests who like a minimalist, Scandinavian-influenced room
Business travelers who need meeting space and business services

facts.text: The hotel sits at the crossroads of Beacon Hill, Downtown Crossing and the Financial District.
The hotel is moments from Boston Common, the Freedom Trail and the city's theaters.
The hotel has a 24-hour Technogym fitness center.
a.bar is an intimate lobby lounge with rich wood paneling, sleek accents and moody lighting.
The on-site restaurant, The Bosworth, blends New England flavors with Mediterranean-inspired cooking.
Services include valet parking, Tesla charging stations, laundry, dry cleaning and business services.
The guest services team is available 24/7.
The hotel has versatile meeting and event spaces.

highlights.text: Condé Nast Traveler's 2025 Readers' Choice Awards named the hotel one of the Top 50 Hotels in the World and ranked it #3 in Boston.
The hotel's reimagined public spaces, including the lobby, were designed by Rafael de Cárdenas.
The redesigned guest rooms are by Studio NA.GI, with minimalist Scandinavian influences.
The 1,000-square-foot penthouse has floor-to-ceiling windows framing panoramic city views.

considerations.text: This is a downtown city hotel at the crossroads of Beacon Hill, Downtown Crossing and the Financial District, amid the city's energy.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of downtown Boston luxury hotels.
WhataHotel notes city noise considerations in the urban setting.
